ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a vertical wall marked with diagonal lines; wooden block A is located at the upper left, with its left side in contact with the vertical wall; wooden block B is located below A and is placed on the horizontal ground; the contact surface between A and B is an inclined surface, and A does not directly contact the horizontal ground. In the figure, there is also an external force F directed to the left on the right side of B, but this force is not a force acting directly on A. Reasoning: Analyze the forces on wooden block A. A must be acted on by its own gravity; because the left side of A rests against a smooth vertical wall, the wall can only exert a horizontal supporting force on A and cannot exert a frictional force; A is in contact with B at the inclined contact surface, and B exerts at least one supporting force perpendicular to the contact surface on A. If there is a tendency of relative motion at the contact surface, there may also be friction, but the question asks "may be acted on by how many forces"; when the frictional force between the contact surfaces of A and B is exactly zero, A is acted on only by these three forces: gravity, the wall's supporting force, and B's supporting force.

method.method_draft: 先从图中识别木块A的位置：A在左上方，左侧与竖直墙接触，下方通过倾斜接触面与木块B接触，A本身不直接压在水平地面上。再结合题干“墙面光滑”，判断墙对A只可能有一个水平支持力、无摩擦力；A自身一定受重力；B对A在倾斜接触面上至少有一个法向支持力。由于问的是“可能”受几个力，若A、B接触面上的摩擦力恰好为零，则A只受重力、墙的支持力、B的支持力三个力，因此答案为三个力。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是一面带斜线标记的竖直墙，木块A位于左上方，左侧与竖直墙接触；木块B位于A的下方并放在水平地面上；A、B之间的接触面是倾斜面，A没有直接接触水平地面。图中B右侧还有一个向左的外力F，但该力不是直接作用在A上的力。
推理：对木块A受力分析。A一定受自身重力；由于A左侧靠在光滑竖直墙面上，墙面对A只能有水平支持力，不能有摩擦力；A与B在倾斜接触面接触，B对A至少有一个垂直于接触面的支持力。接触面处若存在相对运动趋势，还可能有摩擦力，但题目问“可能受几个力”，当A、B接触面间摩擦力恰好为零时，A只受重力、墙的支持力、B的支持力这三个力。
